title: Clip and copy a transparent sprite
audience: Students with basic programming knowledge learning assembly
prerequisites: Strided word arrays and full-width addresses
learningObjectives: Clip all four rectangle edges before addressing
Separate logical width from row stride
Check write history as well as final pixels
Measure native work while retaining the full behavior contract

progression.localImplementation: Native chapter, incremental edits and callable CLI checks; trainer and capture runner pending

choices.text: All visible source pixels, including transparent pixels.

hints.text: The default sprite is placed at x minus two, y one.
Expect twelve visible cells and eight opaque cells selected for copy.

choices.text: To advance the next row by its stride independently of inner-loop cursor movement.

hints.text: Copy the current row starts into t0 and t1 and the copy width into t2.

hints.text: Load one source word and increment the visible count.

quiz.prompt: Which paths advance the cursors?

steps.title: Advance each row start by its own stride

hints.text: Add the destination byte stride to the destination row start and the source byte stride to the source row start.
